description: This bar chart illustrates the Shapley value for three different models—mBERT, XLM-R, and chLSTM—across seven distinct categories labeled L₄⁺, L₃, L₂, L₁, T, R₁, R₂, R₃, and R₄⁺, with the vertical axis representing the Shapley value ranging from 0 to 80 in linear increments, and the horizontal axis listing the categories in left-to-right order. The chart employs grouped bars for each category, with each group containing three bars colored light blue for mBERT, dark blue for XLM-R, and light green for chLSTM. The Shapley values for each model across the categories are as follows: for L₄⁺, mBERT is approximately 5, XLM-R is approximately 5, and chLSTM is approximately 0; for L₃, mBERT is approximately 1, XLM-R is approximately 1, and chLSTM is approximately 0; for L₂, mBERT is approximately 3, XLM-R is approximately 3, and chLSTM is approximately 1; for L₁, mBERT is approximately 13, XLM-R is approximately 13, and chLSTM is approximately 13; for T, mBERT is approximately 60, XLM-R is approximately 55, and chLSTM is approximately 80; for R₁, mBERT is approximately 9, XLM-R is approximately 9, and chLSTM is approximately 9; for R₂, mBERT is approximately 2, XLM-R is approximately 2, and chLSTM is approximately 1; for R₃, mBERT is approximately 0, XLM-R is approximately 0, and chLSTM is approximately 0; and for R₄⁺, mBERT is approximately 3, XLM-R is approximately 3, and chLSTM is approximately 0. The bars are not sorted, and no bars are visually emphasized beyond their standard presentation.
